summary: Verified iteration_65 Homepage Modules admin panel (5 toggles). Backend pytest 5/5 PASS: GET /api/settings and GET /api/admin/settings expose all 5 flags with default True (dj_live_banner_enabled, karaoke_signup_banner_enabled, song_request_banner_enabled, marietta_coming_soon_enabled, featured_events_enabled); PUT /api/admin/settings round-trips each flag false↔true independently without affecting others; unknown keys are correctly ignored (allow-list enforced). Frontend admin: DJ Control tab renders data-testid='homepage-modules-card' with all 5 rows home-module-row-{key} and toggle buttons home-module-toggle-{key}, all initial aria-pressed='true'. Toggling marietta_coming_soon_enabled fired PUT (verified by GET showing false). Homepage gating verified end-to-end: with marietta_coming_soon_enabled=false the [data-testid='coming-soon-marietta-banner'] is NOT in the DOM (screenshot); flipping back to true → orange 'COMING SOON MARIETTA, GEORGIA!!' banner reappears. With featured_events_enabled=false the [data-testid='featured-events-section'] is NOT in the DOM; with true it renders the event grid. Regression: dj-live-banner_enabled flag path preserved from iteration_64. DJ Control tab regressions confirmed: [data-testid='emergency-broadcast-card'] present, and 'ON SHIFT'/'OFF SHIFT' section headings present in DOM. All 5 flags left ON at the end (verified via GET /api/settings). song_request_banner_enabled and karaoke_signup_banner_enabled visible-effect gates were code-verified in LinkTreeHomePage.jsx (lines 1554, 1565: `{karaokeSignupEnabled && karaokeLocation && ...}` and `{songRequestEnabled && !karaokeLocation && djLocation && ...}`) — the flag properly gates the existing DJ/karaoke conditional as required.

test_results.toggle_click_fires_PUT_and_persists: PASS (marietta off verified via GET; dj_live_banner off verified via GET)
test_results.regression_iteration_64_dj_live_banner_f: PASS (flag preserved, key intact in allow-list, admin toggle present)

critical_code_review_comments: DJControlTab.jsx uses window.location.origin for API_URL (pre-existing carryover from iter_64); should be REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Not blocking — same origin via ingress in preview.
get_current_admin is app-wide no-op — PUT /api/admin/settings is reachable without auth token in preview (pre-existing, longstanding P2).

In DJControlTab.jsx the HOMEPAGE_MODULES useEffect dependency is empty [] but reads HOMEPAGE_MODULES which is redefined every render — currently safe because content is stable, but ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps would flag it. Consider hoisting HOMEPAGE_MODULES outside the component.
test_credentials: admin / $outhcentral (admin gate is app-wide no-op; endpoint reachable without token in preview per iteration_64 note).
seed_data_creation: None. All 5 flags mutated during test and restored to True at the end (verified via GET /api/settings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Five app-wide flags live in db.app_settings _id='global': dj_live_banner_enabled, karaoke_signup_banner_enabled, song_request_banner_enabled, marietta_coming_soon_enabled, featured_events_enabled. All default True. Public GET /api/settings, admin GET/PUT /api/admin/settings (allow-list of 8 keys including the 3 pre-existing token/loyalty/buy_drink). Admin UI: data-testid='homepage-modules-card' with home-module-row-{key} rows and home-module-toggle-{key} buttons (aria-pressed reflects state). Homepage gates: coming-soon-marietta-banner and featured-events-section testids on LinkTreeHomePage; karaoke_signup and song_request are AND-gated with pre-existing karaokeLocation/djLocation conditionals so they only visibly change when a session is active. Playwright note: React toast lib may trigger short unmount/remount of buttons after PUT — use requests.get to verify persistence rather than re-querying the button element to avoid 'GONE'/'execution context destroyed' flakiness.
